lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form III) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَسَاهَمَ is in the derivative form: ساهَمَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/هـ/م s–h–m share, luck; arrow; area of land, drawing lots, haggardness of face. Of this root, only ساهَمَ sāhama occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ساهَمَ sāhama [v. III, intrans.] to draw lots

(37:140-1) إِذْ‏ ‏أَبَقَ‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏الْفُلْكِ‏ ‏الْمَشْحُونِ‏ ‏فَسَاهَمَ‏ ‏فَكَانَ‏ ‏مِنَ‏ ‏الْمُدْحَضِينَ he fled to the overloaded ship, cast lots, and suffered defeat.
